Definition

A diagnostic tool that decomposes return on equity into profit margin, asset turnover, and equity multiplier to isolate drivers of financial performance.

Operational example

DuPont analysis helps analysts break down ROE to identify whether profitability, efficiency, or leverage is the main driver of returns.

Localized term
